reason: Original exact search for an M1 steel coupling connector nut returned no exact M1 product; shown steel listings began at M6 or larger and other results were stainless steel. The completed DIN 6334 refinement showed supplier ranges beginning at M5 and larger; no eligible M1 steel coupling nut appeared in either completed search.
search_evidence: First completed Google search: https://www.google.com/search?q=M1+coupling+connector+nut+steel. Results included coupling nut products from M3/M4 or M5/M6 upwards, M10 and M16 steel examples, and stainless steel options; no M1 candidate. Second completed Google search: https://www.google.com/search?q=M1+DIN+6334+steel+connector+nut. Supplier results identified M5-M30 and M6/M8/M10/M12/M16/M20 as standard connector nut ranges, along with larger steel examples; no M1 product.

attempts.outcome: No exact M1 coupling nut. Displayed steel products were M10/M16 and larger; other connector-nut options began M3-M6 or were stainless.
No eligible M1 DIN 6334 steel nut; supplier ranges shown began M5 and larger.
